sentences.text:
To prove its case, prosecution examined PW1 (complainant) Jagan Prasad, father of deceased,
who deposed that deceased Preeti got married to accused Sandeep in 2020 and in the marriage, he gave dowry articles as per his financial capacity.
His wife Amarbati (PW2) used to talk to Preeti, who used to tell her mother that she is happy with accused Sandeep.
In the year 2022, he received a call from in-laws of Preeti that she has committed suicide by hanging.
Thereafter, he alongwith his family members and relatives came to matrimonial home of deceased.
Thereafter, he went to DDU Hospital, where he identified dead body of his daughter Preeti vide his statement Ex.PW1/A and received dead body vide memo Ex.PW1/B.

He also deposed that SDM concerned inquired the Sc No: 93/23 State vs . Rakesh Kumar & Others on 5 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/79267914/
3 matter from him.

sentences.text: Since complainant (PW1) did not support prosecution case, he was declared a hostile witness.

PW1 was cross- examined by ld. Additional PP and during his cross- examination, he maintained that accused persons did not make any demand of dowry from him, his family as well as his deceased daughter Preeti nor deceased was subjected to cruelty for demand of dowry at any point of time.
11. PW2 Amarbati (mother of deceased) deposed her deceased daughter Preeti used to talk to her occasionally and Preeti used to told her that she is happy with accused Sandeep.

In the year 2022,
her husband received a call from in-laws of Preeti that she has committed suicide by hanging.
Thereafter, she alongwith her family members went to matrimonial home of Preeti.
PW2 also did not support prosecution case and she was declared a hostile witness.
PW2 was cross-examined by ld.
Additional PP at length but Judgment 7 of 14 SC No: 93/23 State Vs. Rakesh Kumar & Others no incriminating material could be elucidated from her testimony also.

sentences.text: PW2 categorically deposed that accused persons did not make any demand of dowry from her, her family as well as her deceased daughter Preeti at any point of time nor deceased was subjected to cruelty for demand of dowry at any point of time.
Kusum neighbor of deceased Preeti deposed that on 23.10.2022, when she was washing clothes on her floor, she heard noises of knocking door from second floor.
Hearing noise, she rushed to second floor and saw that accused Rajvati was banging the door of the room and was asking deceased to open the door.
Sister-in-law of deceased was also asking deceased to open the door.
PW3 asked accused Sandeep to broke open the door.
Other people also gathered there and tried to broke the door but in vain.
Then sister-in- law of deceased broke the window of the room and opened Judgment 8 of 14 SC No: 93/23 State Vs. Rakesh Kumar & Others the latch of the door.

sentences.text: Deceased was found hanging on ceiling fan.
People gathered there alongwith accused Sandeep brought down deceased from ceiling fan.
Then police reached at the spot and she narrated about the incident to police.
PW3 was cross

defence counsel but no incriminating material against accused persons could be elucidated from her testimony.

PX-3 regarding he reached at the spot.
He inspected the spot.
Crime Team was called.
Father of deceased Preeti was informed about the incident.
Dupatta by which deceased hanged herself was seized by him vide seizure memo Ex.PW4/A.
He prepared rough site plan Ex.PW4/B and brief facts of case Ex.PW4/C.

sentences.text: Complainant (PW1) who is father of deceased did not support prosecution case in respect of the allegations appearing in the FIR.

Complainant deposed that accused persons did not make any demand of dowry from him, his family as well as his deceased daughter Preeti at any point of time nor deceased was subjected to cruelty for demand of dowry at any point of time.
19. PW2 who is mother of deceased, deposed on the same lines as deposed by PW1.

PW2 also deposed that accused persons did not make any demand of dowry from her, her family as well as her deceased daughter Preeti at any point of time nor deceased was subjected to cruelty for demand of dowry at any point of time.

sentences.text: PW3 deposed nothing incriminating against accused persons and testified that Preeti was found hanging in her room and persons gathered at the spot alongwith accused Sandeep brought down deceased from ceiling fan.
No other witness is cited or examined by the prosecution who could have Sc No: 93/23 State vs .

Postmortem report Ex PX-8 establishes that manner of death of Preeti is suicidal and no act is attributed to the accused persons to held them responsible for commission of suicide by deceased.
21.

In the light of testimonies of complainant (PW1) and his wife (PW2) who are parents of deceased and independent witness PW3 which are exonerating accused persons, it is held that prosecution has failed to establish charge against accused persons.

Accordingly, accused persons Rakesh Kumar,
Sandeep Kumar and Rajvati are acquitted.
